panel.introduction: Orcus is a large resonant world beyond Neptune, partnered with the substantial moon Vanth. The displayed size belongs to Orcus alone; its smooth shape and grid surface are illustrative.

facts.label: Rotation
facts.value: Possibly synchronized with Vanth’s roughly 9.54-day orbit; no qualified sidereal spin is installed.

moreFacts.label: Shape interpretation
moreFacts.value: Size-constrained spherical illustration at Orcus’s primary-only thermal diameter, 910 +50/−40 km. ALMA separated the binary components but did not resolve Orcus’s terrain or measure three shape axes.

controls.label: Shape model
controls.description: Size-constrained spherical illustration at Orcus’s primary-only thermal diameter, 910 +50/−40 km. ALMA separated the binary components but did not resolve Orcus’s terrain or measure three shape axes. Illustrative ICRF north pole (RA 0°, Dec +90°), arbitrary prime meridian and phase. No measured body pole or absolute surface attitude is claimed. The grid marks unmapped terrain.
controls.title: Published size model; shape unresolved

resources.label: Shape source
resources.description: Brown and Butler (2018), resolved ALMA binary photometry with Spitzer/Herschel thermal modeling.
